page_title: VAL 1-0 PAL | Valencia v Las Palmas 18/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+11' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
90+10' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+9' Las Palmas work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+8' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Iglesias Villanueva no option but to blow his whistle.
90+6' Jose Gaya (Valencia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

90+4' Pejino (Las Palmas) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Giorgi Mamardashvili has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
90+3' Thierry Correia (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+2' The game is interrupted now, Thierry Correia (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
89' Close! Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
88' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle after Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
85' The corner from Pepelu (Valencia) is intercepted by the defence.
84' Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
84' Corner kick. Pepelu (Valencia) is ready to send the ball into the box.
82' That's the end of the game for Mika Marmol, who is replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
82' That will be all from Kirian who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marc Cardona Rovira (Las Palmas).
82' Ruben Baraja decides to make a substitution. Francisco Perez will be replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
82' Substitution. Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia) replaces Hugo Duro.
78' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is able to continue to play.
77' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

77' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Hugo Duro (Valencia) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alvaro Valles pulls off a brilliant save.
74' 1 - 0 Pepelu (Valencia) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Alvaro Valles to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
74' Pepelu (Valencia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
73' The Valencia players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

72' There's a break in play and referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Valencia using VAR. This could be interesting!
71' That looked a certain handball by Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
71' Thierry Correia (Valencia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Mouctar Diakhaby can be given a rest.
70' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Diego Lopez is replaced by Pablo Gozalbez (Valencia).
66' Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva sees the trip by Pepelu (Valencia) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
64' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is penalised for a foul. Javier Iglesias Villanueva had a clear view and blows his whistle.
64' Pejino (Las Palmas) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Munir El Haddadi.
62' Hugo Duro (Valencia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
62' Pepelu (Valencia) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
62' Javi Guerra (Valencia) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
61' The linesman signals that Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
57' Diego Lopez (Valencia) dribbles into the box, but Alvaro Valles is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

56' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
56' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Substitution. Andre Almeida makes his way off the pitch and Javi Guerra (Valencia) comes on as his replacement.
56' The attendance is 41053.
55' The game is interrupted now, Pepelu (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
53' Thierry Correia (Valencia) jumps into a tackle and Javier Iglesias Villanueva signals a foul.
52' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
49' A spell of possession for Las Palmas in an attempt to control the game.

46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alvaro Lemos (Las Palmas). He is replaced by Julian Araujo.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner.
45+3' Valencia keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
41' Thierry Correia (Valencia) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Alvaro Valles.
38' Las Palmas are seeing far more of the ball now.
35' Francisco Perez (Valencia) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva signals.
31' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
28' Andre Almeida (Valencia) steps up to send the ball in.
27' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' Daley Sinkgraven is being substituted because of an injury. Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta sends Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) on the pitch.
21' Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
20' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
18' Hugo Duro (Valencia) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

16' A sweet pass finds Diego Lopez (Valencia) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Alvaro Valles is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
14' A quickly taken corner by Las Palmas.
13' Some great controlled play and passing from Las Palmas. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
9' The ball is cleared after Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Francisco Perez (Valencia) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
6' Andre Almeida (Valencia) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
6' Valencia players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
3' Andre Almeida (Valencia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva will referee today's match.
